content:
**Radscorpion Fillet** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Radscorpion Meat that has been battered in Radscorpion Eggs and cooked. It gives a 60 minute boost to Energy Resistance while restoring a very large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.
